name: P-H3-Image — edit a picture
title: Change a picture by asking
summary: Upload a picture and say what to change: "make it night", "paint the door red". Say what must stay as it is, too: its prompt writer, which would do that for you, does not run on this machine yet.
description:
Pruna's P-H3-Image edits a picture from a request, run here as a LoRA on MiniMax H3.

The model edits best from a brief that names what to change and what to keep ("Make it night; keep the people, the building and the framing"); a bare request can make it redraw the whole scene.

It comes with a prompt upsampler (a Qwen3.5-9B writer) that looks at the picture and writes that brief. On this ComfyUI build the writer fails (a bug in the Qwen 3.5 decode, the same one that stops the other prompt improvers), so it is off.

The result has the size of the picture you upload (up to 2048 × 2048). It takes 8 steps, without a negative prompt.

promptGuides.label: P-H3-Image — prompting (Pruna)
promptGuides.tip: A one-line request is enough: the prompt upsampler writes the full prompt. Put any words to be written in quotes.
